author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
With AI coding, everyone is a lot busier, but the revenue increase does not materialize, business minds are wondering where the productivity increase is.  

The reality is the tech minds are busying fixing decades worth of technical debts.  If you don't have a good foundation, your code will collapse from the weight of AI coding.   

In the pre AI-era, the technical debts disappear when the companies become irreverent.  
In the post AI-era, things move so fast that we are forced deal with the technical debts
